body-length.description: Actual response body size in bytes, independently of a Content-Length header.

content-type.description: Media type of the response body.

header.description: One complete HTTP response header per attribute in name: value form; retain duplicate header lines as separate attributes.

latency-ms.description: Observed HTTP response latency in milliseconds.

length.description: Size of the complete response in bytes.

message.description: HTTP status line or reason phrase as recorded by the source.

status.description: Source response status label, such as OK.

status-code.description: HTTP status code returned by the server, such as 200 or 404.

description: One observed HTTP response, including status, headers, sizes and response latency. Relate it to its request and network connection. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/http_response.
name: http-response
